Complete [[Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defend the G.O.L.E.M. kilns and destroy the [[Destroyer]] hive outside [[Rata Sum]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Asura reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[G.O.L.E.M.#Walkthrough|G.O.L.E.M. walkthrough]].
